BiblicalUsage: Telach, also spelled Telah, was named in the line of Ephraim, in the chain from Rephah through Resheph to Tahan. He stands in the genealogy of Ephraim's house, a link between the fathers and the sons.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the chain of names is the chain of the promise, and Telach's link is kept.
